decisions.reason: The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes Big Block references from the affected FAQ descriptions and updates the primary-mint split.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already narrows the no-code ticket award to a Small Block prize ticket; its trigger, recipient eligibility, and commission remain unchanged.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes the obsolete Big Block counter, eligibility window, and post-draw action while retaining the operational removal fact.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes the Big Block ticket counter from NFT metadata.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already narrows eligible winners to holders of current Small Block tickets; the randomness and fairness rules remain unchanged.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already sets the primary-mint prize allocation to $5 and identifies the Small Block pool as the active prize pool; secondary-sale funding is not revoked by the source.
Eliminating Big Blocks leaves the existing Small Block winner count, $500 award, eligible population, and 100-sale trigger unchanged.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already records the $5 founder share, $5 referral commission, $5 Small Block pool allocation, and replacement of the obsolete generic prize-pool funding key.
Removing Big Blocks does not alter the automatic prize-transfer workflow or winner notification channels for the remaining Small Block prizes.
The source changes primary-mint allocation and removes Big Blocks but does not change the required $10 flat secondary-sale royalty.
The NFT mint number remains the permanent referral code in all established display and confirmation locations.
The removal of Big Blocks and revised revenue split do not change referral badge conditions or milestone thresholds.
